policy: Applies only to future uploads, never silently modifies existing videos. Story-specific text and tags are supplied by the episode manifest.

description.call_to_action: Inscreva-se no Otaku Multicena para mais histórias e análises de anime. Conte sua opinião nos comentários!
description.original_content_notice: Conteúdo independente com comentário, narração, edição e ilustrações geradas por IA. Os animes e personagens pertencem aos respectivos titulares.

description.call_to_action: Subscribe to Otaku Reframe for more anime stories and character analysis. Who would you side with?
description.original_content_notice: Independent anime commentary featuring original narration, editing and AI-generated illustrations. Series and characters belong to their respective rights holders.

studio_only.age_restriction: Not automatically set via videos.insert; review if story contains content requiring age restriction.
studio_only.comments: Moderation and who can comment are channel/Studio controls; user example BR none, EN basic.
studio_only.chapters: Automatic chapters setting not controlled by this API upload.
studio_only.auto_places: Automatic location detection not controlled by this API upload.
studio_only.auto_concepts: Automatic concept definitions not controlled by this API upload.
studio_only.remixes: Audio/video remix allowance not controlled by this API upload.
studio_only.captions_certification: No certification when not required; check in Studio.
studio_only.video_audio_language: Verify recorded language in Studio; snippet.defaultLanguage is metadata language, not a guarantee of video language.
studio_only.subtitles: Burned-in subtitles produced by Remotion; optional native caption track requires captions.insert authorization.
studio_only.paid_promotion: Only mark paid promotion when actual sponsorship exists. Requires separate Studio review.
studio_only.ai_disclosure: If materially altered or realistic synthetic content is present, explicitly set containsSyntheticMedia=true in episode metadata. For non-realistic animations, review YouTube policy and do not automatically infer.
studio_only.youtube_short_thumbnail: Upload the original channel-specific vertical JPG with thumbnails.set after successful processing; API acceptance does not guarantee where Shorts surfaces display it.
studio_only.notifications: notifySubscribers=true on upload, actual subscriber notifications depend on visibility and YouTube behavior.
studio_only.like_count_display: Not guaranteed by status.publicStatsViewable; verify in Studio.
